Under the Service-table rule (Bill, 2026-10-14), service mentioned on a person page must be a cited row in its == Service == table. The article was left unchanged; please add a source (and then a Service row), or remove the claim. == Two-Player Game rules credit (27 October 2026) ==

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet thanks "Mike Gray and Carol Wisely: for turning a million instructions into fewer rules" ([https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet] (1995), credits page ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Preserved copy])). Decipher made that game with Parker Brothers, which distributed it. So this Mike Gray may be the Parker Brothers and Hasbro game designer Michael Gray (a Milton Bradley and Hasbro designer whose published bio does not mention Decipher or ''Star Wars''). That identification is possible but unconfirmed: the sources found do not name him on the Star Wars CCG two-player game, and the fan anagram list calls Mike Gray a Decipherian. The article says this as unconfirmed and keeps the Decipherian row.
* No photo: none found that a source ties to the Decipher credit.
